en: I never got to meet my grandpa, but I know I'll make him proud.
You can only run from the law for so long.
When I find who I'm looking for, I'm not bringing him in. I'm putting him down.
I let my town down once, but I'm gonna make it right today.
Justice isn't always swift, but it comes for everyone.
I'll complete the ritual, and I'll find who I'm looking for.
I'm not leaving New York until I stop the Troubadour!
If I'm gonna stop that sick bastard, I'm gonna need the Patron's help.
The sooner I stop the Troubadour, the sooner I can go back home.
I don't have time to mess around with the ritual, lives are at stake!
I should, uh... check in with people back home.
I got a lead on the Troubadour that I need to follow up on.
If you change your mind, I'll be around.
Heard reports another body was found. I need to investigate.
Sounds like my investigation is rubbing people the wrong way.
You got my hopes up. Hope you're happy.
Come on, don't put me on the shelf!
At this rate, this case is never gonna get solved!
You're the sheriff from Macomb, right?
Eh, I don't know... I was thinking you grab them and then I punch their skull in!
Holliday... I don't suppose you're related to...
I try not to think about it.
I'm the person who's putting his life in the hands of an emotional trainwreck on a suicide mission.
Do I look like Grey Talon?
Grey Talon has discipline that you could only dream about. I'm amazed you haven't accidently fired your gun already.
You know how to use that sword?
No, I'm carrying it because I'm in Macbeth. What do you think?
This is gonna be a long day...
Be ready to stab 'em when I bring 'em in close.
Don't see too many golems in Macomb.
Don't see too many cowboys in New York.
Isn't a sheriff just a cowboy with a badge?
I'll pull them in, you grab 'em?
I like the way you think, tin man!
I know it's against your nature... programming, or whatever. But there are gonna be times when I need you not to punch someone right after you pull 'em.
Hmm... you're right that it does seem rather counter-intuitive.
Just let me grab them first. Then feel free to beat the hell out of them.
You think it's safe, bringing her out here?
Don't worry about us, sheriff. We'll be fine.
Rumor is, you were in the Baxter Society!
You ever hear of something called "The Troubadour"?
Enough to know to stay away from it.
You're not much of a talker, are you?
God, you and Wesley would get along famously.
You looking for the Troubadour, eh?
That's right. You got a tip for me?
Yeah, you don't wanna find him.
I'm getting real tired of people telling me that.
Macomb matters a lot to you, but to him it was just a fun time that'll get lost in the ocean of memory... but if you find him, if he knows he got his hooks in you? You gonna be his hobby.
Oh, I wouldn't want to spoil the surprise, but trust me, Sheriff. For your sake: let it go.
Tie them down, Holliday, and leave the rest to me.
I don't take orders from you!
You want them dead? Tie them down for me.
You spell Holliday with one "L" or two?
I know whose gun that is. You gon' be able to make him proud?
I'm glad you're here, sheriff. If the Troubadour's in New York, the city's gonna need your expertise.
Yeah, well I hope local law enforcement feels the same way.
Sheriff, I do my best to be precise, but sometimes even I miscalculate the area of a black hole. If you would be so kind...
I'm happy to drag back anyone you miss.
Read about what happened in Macomb. Absolutely ghoulish.
I really don't wanna talk about it.
Understandable. I just... I just hope you catch whoever's responsible.
I'm not gonna catch him. I'm gonna kill him.
I really need to get my tubes tied...
When the ritual starts, go find a playground to brood in.
Snark isn't gonna keep you alive.
You shouldn't be here. It's not safe.
I can take care of myself.
So, do they give you the pack of cloves when you become a theatre kid, or was that something you brought to the table all on your own?
And I'm hoping you get shot.
What do you want from the Patron?
Can I give you an unsolicited word of advice, Holliday?

People are going to tell you that there is a difference between justice and revenge. That you will dishonor the dead by stooping to their killer's level. Ignore them. Revenge isn't for the dead. It's for the living.
I know that look in your eyes. Who did they take from you?
I hope today we both find peace.
I've read your file, sheriff. You seem competent.
We're the OSIC. Of course there's a file.
You don't have any issues working with the OSIC, do you?
I'm happy to work with anyone who doesn't get in my way.
Don't worry, sheriff. I think our partnership will be good for everyone.
You sleep 'em, I grab 'em, you shoot 'em.
You had no right to jump in my head.
I would think you of all people would appreciate the ends justifying the means.
You should have told me what you were gonna do.
I don't waste time. I get results.
I thought you'd be back on your way to Macomb.
There are some loose ends I'm trying to tie up.
I'm gonna kill that goddamn receptionist!
I don't think I ever said "Thank you".
No need to thank me. We both were doing our job.
We didn't just stop the Troubadour. You kept me from crossing a line, and I owe you for that.
We can talk later. Let's focus on the task at hand.
Well... he'd do the same for me.
Bet you had quite the life before you became a bartender?
I'm not sure if the statute of limitations lets me answer that question, honestly.
How about when this is over, we have a chat at the bar?
Not afraid. Just don't like it.
Are you angry like, all the time?
You know, my sister told me that when I get mad, I should take a deep breath and count to four. It doesn't always work, but sometimes it does!
Y-yeah, I'm... going to shut up now.
Heard about you on the news.
I am. Turns out lots of people are interested in crimefighting gargoyles.
Were they saying nice things, at least?
Ivy, it's hard not to say nice things about you.
So, what do you think of New York?
I'm here to catch a killer, not go sightseeing.

Ok, so, that's totally fair, but! If you decide to go sightseeing, let me know. I've only recently started leaving Spanish Harlem, so it would be nice to have someone to do stuff with that's not in my family. N-Not that there's anything wrong with my family! I love-
You look more out of place than I do.
The dead rarely are consumed by fashion.
My friend, I wish I knew. I'm just looking for answers.
If all goes well, it ends today.
It was a gift from my husband.
You know how to use it?
It looks like we're about to find out, aren't we?
I don't mean to be rude...
I'm relieved to know that you have eyes, Sheriff.
You've done some horrible things, and after I stop the Troubadour, I'm gonna find out what.
So... you using that rope for work or recreation?
Small town lady looking to get a... taste of the big city?
I'm tracking down a serial killer.
If you're looking for someone with a body count, I'm turning myself in.
Oh my God, I hate you.
Lash, here's the thing: I'm gonna need you to talk to me as little as humanly possible.
I don't knock your teeth in.
What's it like working for Fairfax?
You ever work with rich people?
Nah, I'm from Central Illinois. I just assume they're assholes with god complexes.
You were that kid genius, right?
How that worked out for you?
I'm the lead engineer for the Occult Industrial Complex?
How long you think you'll stay with Fairfax Industries?
I don't know. Probably until I get bored or open some portal to hell and die?
Eh, I think about it a lot.
You... really think the US is gonna sell Wyoming to the Djinn?
I think the US is interested in money... and power. And the Djinn can offer both.
That's the problem, you won't. And when you cling to that path... you'll die because of it.
I do. When she's free of her vessel, she offers... scintillating conversation. When she rests... I get to go bowling.
I learned about it in England, it is the sport of kings.
Your revolver is a thing to behold.
Thanks. It belonged to my grandfather.
I don't suppose it's for sale...
I wouldn't respect myself if I didn't ask!
Sheriff, I know that you're new to our great city. But if you ever find yourself in need of information, Mo and I are happy to avail ourselves to you.
I bet you are. How much you charge?
I think you'll find our rates to be... reasonable.
Just pull them to Maurice, and I'll make sure we finish the job!
We're... not going to have any problems, right Sheriff?
I don't care about you or your friends.
In that case, welcome to New York!
Don't trust the OSIC. Their goals and your goals are not in alignment.
How often do you take the mask off?
You think I keep this on all the time?
Lady, you're running around with a fishbowl on your head, I think it's safe not to assume anything.
So, what's your story, lady? You fall in a vat of clocks?
It's not wise to mock Paradox.
Yes, you are. And I need to know if I have to look after you.
You don't... but it's nice to hear someone say that.
You look like you've lived a life.
You think we're gonna be able to summon the Patron, sheriff?
I think that if we don't, we'll be dead, so it's not gonna matter a whole hell of a lot.
I'm sorry, I don't know the area. Have you talked to the police?
Have you talked to the police that live here?
Why would I do that when I'm talking to you?
Cause they–... Just stay close to me, we'll talk after the Ritual.
So you're the sheriff from Macomb.
And you're the one who escaped Lost Whisper.
This should prove to be interesting.
Hmm... Look at you. So consumed by revenge that you would even fight alongside me.
Apologies. I would never dream of upsetting you, Holliday.
When this is over, I have to turn you in.
When this is over, if you're determined to throw your life away, I would be happy to take it.
You haven't heard? She's writing a story about me.
Rejoice, Holliday. Soon you will get the revenge you seek.
Only if we summon this thing.
Look who stands with you. They don't have a chance.
I can't believe the OSIC wanted to recruit that thing.
You're too smart to be that naive.
So you're with the Baxter Society?
Hand picked by the old man himself.
How come the Baxter Society isn't trying to stop the Troubadour?
We got our own problems right now.
Must be nice having the luxury to drag your feet while innocent people are dying.
Trust me, Sheriff. If we don't clean up our own house you'll be wishing for Troubadour-sized problems.
You’re the one looking to kill the Troubadour, right?
You make it out alive, you should look up the Baxter Society. We could use someone like you.
You know, Sheriff, I'm kind of an expert on self-destruction. If you ever wanna talk about-
Seem a little far from your jurisdiction.
What I'm doing here is none of your business.
I just wanna make sure you're not tryna make a career change.
I'm not going after one of your bounties, Silver. Once I stop the Troubadour, I'm going back home.
Us trainwrecks need to stick together.
Yeah, your life is totally goin' great.
Hope you're better at fighting than you are at magic.
Yeah? Then why are you dead?
You're the guy that throws cards at people, right?
Oh. So what do you do?
I can see why your wife left you.
What happened in Macomb wasn't your fault, child.
No... but I've failed before. You can't let it consume you.
I didn't say don't care. Pain and anger are fires that burn in all of us, but it needs to be tended lest it destroys you.
Yeah? And how do you tend it?
Harden your heart, Sheriff. You can't let your sense of law and order get in the way of what needs to be done.
Don't worry, Father. The law is the farthest thing from driving me.
Thanks for praying with me earlier.
I hope it... brought you some peace.
It didn't. But it was nice that you tried!
Forgive me for not being as chatty as some of the other folks around here.
That's fine. I don't mind the silence.
Whole lotta things are bothering me. Nothing you can help with though.
Bring them to me. I'll make them suffer.
How good are you at hitting moving targets?
I shot Hathorne's brother while he was day-drinking on a speedboat.
... I'm gonna pretend that was a joke.
You know I have to arrest you now?
When this is over, you are more than welcome to try.
Bind them, Sheriff. And leave the rest to me.
Forgive me for not having much faith in servants of the law.
Law has come a long way since you died.
Tell you what: If we win, sure.
You don't know what I said, do you?
When I'm in the Cube, it's warm. I like being in the Cube. You seem to like revenge, so I wonder if it feels the same.
No Viscous, it, um... it doesn't feel warm.
Then why do you want to live in it?
Because there's nothing else I can do about it.
Because, uh, you like the law, or... because you like being on a power trip?
I'm just tryin' to figure out if we could be friends!
Yeah, so we should not be friends.
Doubt it. I'm not from around here.
No shit? You know, I did a little time in Cook County.
Well, If you ever find yourself in the BG, just... pretend you don't know me, okay? I don't want people knowin' I'm tight with a cop.
No, I didn't say you were, I'm just saying you're being needlessly hostile.
If you didn't need my help right now, you would stab me in the back!
Ok, sorry, you are really good at reading people, 'cause at first I was offended, but now I'm like, kind of impressed!
I'm guessing I don't need to remind you that the stakes are high?
So what are you supposed to be?
Well, you look like you're dressed up for Halloween, so I figured I'd ask.
... So you're a creepy homeschooled kid, got it.
Don't worry, Wraith. I'm here for the Troubadour, not your gambling ring.
If you think I'd be worried about a sheriff from Missoula...
Wherever. The point is I don't get scared by cops who probably just experienced running water for the first time in their lives.
You know what? Maybe I'll stay for your gambling ring.
You should quit while you're ahead.
Your organization. Shut it down. Quit while you're ahead.
I will repent all my wicked ways...
No. I think you're a joke.
Either you shut it down, or Murphy's gonna shut it down for you.
まさか警察の犬と協力することになるとはな。(I never thought I'd end up working with a police dog.)
I'm sorry, I don't speak Japanese.
あんたがマーフィーの女か。(You're Murphy's girl.)
What did you say about Murphy?
Don't worry, Sheriff. Play your part and he lives.
Picking a fight with the other families isn't gonna end well for you.
Time for a little fun with TNT.
Can't wait to play with these.
I got a permit for these.
Now's not the time for subtlety.
It's all fun and games until someone kicks a barrel of explosives at ya.
I brought a little surprise from back home.
I'm either gonna blow 'em up or make 'em run like hell. Either works for me!
This stuff's more unstable than my first marriage!
God, I hope this is a good idea.
Hope I know what I'm doing.
I'm gonna get the drop on 'em.
Gonna go in there and give 'em hell.
Sometimes you just gotta jump in.
I'll chase them down wherever they go.
I'm not letting someone escape me again.
I won't give up the chase!
Gotta be ready to jump in!
Hope I got this positioned right.
Ready to get some air time!
Time to do what I do best.
Need to set this up fast.
Come on, come on, come on, come on!
I'm not dying in New York!
I know how to use the family heirloom.
I don't have time to mess around with these people.
Dad gave me the gun, and he damn sure taught me how to use it.
They'll learn not to mess with me.
Sheriff's not just a fancy title: I know how to back it up.
They'll back down, or they'll die.
Ready to lay down the law.
I know how to make it hurt.
Lemme show you why I'm the law.
That's something they can remember me by.
That's something they can remember me by.
I'll grab someone and pull 'em to the group!
I can use Lasso when we're ready.
Ready to jump in and grab 'em!
Got my lasso ready to go!
I know how to tie 'em up.
Gotta isolate 'em one at a time.
Gotta get in there, grab 'em, and get out.
Need a plan before I use this.
Once I got 'em, there's nothing they can do!
Need to communicate before using this thing.
With a little coordination, this can make all the difference.
Take them out before they escape!
I got you, you son of a bitch!
I can handle this by myself.
You guys gonna shoot 'em or what?
I'm not holding 'em for fun here!
There's more where that came from.
No one's a better shot than me.
Probably should talk to local law enforcement about that one.
Great, now there's blood on my boots. Those were a gift!
Was never gonna end well for ya.
You mess with the law, the law's gonna mess with you!
That's what I like to see!
And that's how you do it!
Think it's time to remind them who the law is around here!
Made an example out of another one!
I got somethin' for all of ya!
Come at me all you want, the result's gonna be the same.
You guys gettin' the picture yet?
Just give up, you're only making this worse.
This really the best you got?!
There's gonna be a whooole lot of paperwork to fill out by the time this is over.
You're not stopping me. Not now, not ever!
I'm not worried about their magic.
Might be time to go spend.
Might want to buy a relic.
I can get some new toys!
I can get some new items.
I'll head to the shop when I have time.
You wanna play? Fine by me.
I should pick up those souls.
Shouldn't leave those souls lying around.
Well, what do we have here?
They took the souls, but we took the objective!
One step closer to completing the ritual.
Come on, where did they go?
They won't be so lucky next time.
They're making me work for it today!
I don't have any backup... I need to be careful.
Maybe I should get back to the others.
Wonder what the others are up to?
Gotta hold on until backup arrives.
I can hold this down for a little bit.
They have the Rejuvenator, we gotta play this smart!
I didn't come to New York to be a tourist, I got work to do!
Don't shoot 'em, they have metal skin!
Can't shoot through that metal skin!
I'll be back when I can!
You're on your own for now!
And that's how you do it!
Simple plan. I grab 'em, you shoot 'em.
Let's just summon the damn patron and get outta here!
I am really over New York.
If we work together, everyone's gonna get what they want.
Guys, just don't leave me hangin' once I grab someone!
This place is like Chicago. I hate Chicago!
Can't wait to get back to Macomb.
Way to keep it together, everyone!
That was fun! Scary... But fun!
I got a greyhound to catch.
Come on, big guy, you can do this!
They're about to have a real bad day!
Hope the Guardian can help take 'em out.
I can't believe you hit that!
Grey Talon just ruined their day!
So it looks like Sandmen are as terrifying as the rumours say.
May be a fed, but you're alright, Haze.
Thank God you are here, Haze.
Guess Haze has my back after all.
You're wasting your talents behind a bar, my friend!
That didn't last long, did it?
We make a good team, Ivy!
Geist is up to that creepy stuff again.
I'll give the devil his due: that was something else.
We need you out there, McGinnis!
Seven's a monster, but he's our monster.
That's something you don't see everyday.
Glad that thing is fighting for us.
Vindicta, you have found your calling.
Ah, I think I got some goo on me!
I don't know what that thing is, but he saved my ass!
That guy's got some issues, but I'm glad he's with us.
You're almost making this too easy, Wraith!
Wraith, I hate you as a person, but love you as a teammate!
Just like target practise back home!
Hey, watch where you point that sword, lady!
They thought they were getting away, didn't they?
Abrams... I hoped it wouldn't have come to this...
I don't care who your daddy is!
He thought he was God's gift.
He's still got a lot to learn.
Who brings a sword to a gun fight?
I'm not getting killed by a machine.
Only person grabbin' people is me, Bebop.
At the end of the day, you're just a machine.
Gotta be faster than that, Bebop!
I don't have time for this, goat boy.
Ya never had a chance, Billy.
"Most dangerous woman on the planet", my ass!
That cat deserved better than to be attached to you.
You belong in jail, Calico... But I'll settle for you in the dirt.
No one's above the law, Calico!
I need to get outta this city...
Yeah, I'm not a circus girl.
Glad I'm not staying at the Baroness.
I'm not letting the Doorman toy with me.
I'm not letting another serial killer get away!
Came for a different killer, but I'll settle for you.
One less maniac to deal with.
Give up, Dynamo, it's not gonna get any easier for ya.
Look out for the black hole!
What the hell am I doing?
That kid didn't give me a choice!
Where the hell was that kid's parents?!
God damn it, Talon, I don't wanna do this!
Feelin' pretty conflicted about that one.
Won't be seein' that owl anytime soon.
If I never see a Sandman again, it'll be too soon.
Should've known the OSIC would be here.
Never should've come after me, Haze.
You can't hide from me, Haze.
Not so fancy now, are ya, Haze?
Eh, I'll leave him a tip later.
You picked a bad day to leave the bar.
One less demon to worry about.
Infernus is out of the picture.
Brave move, Infernus!.. Dumb, but brave!
She should've flown away while she could.
I tried to reason with you, Kelvin.
And I thought I was out of place in New York.
Kelvin. You're not ready to fight someone like me.
You're not getting away that easy, Kelvin.
You think you can skate away from me?
You're no better than the Troubadour, Geist.
What the hell was wrong with her arm?
Geist is looking to steal someone's health.
That guy thought he owned the skies.
Lash. Everything you do, I'm just better at.
A little humility'll do him good.
Humbling guys like you never gets old.
Thanks for the target practice, Lash!
One less idiot to deal with.
Those machines didn't work out like you thought they would, huh?
It'll take more than some turrets to stop me.
She keeps making those damn turrets!
How many of these damn things does she have?!
How about you go cry about it to mommy and daddy?
You picked a hell of a time to visit New York.
It was you or me, pal.
Glad I got him before they tore me in half.
Fightin' those two is always risky.
Glad that went my way. Mole men are no joke.
That is one big mole man!
Save storytime for your kindergarten class, or whatever the hell you do.
You're not cut out for this, Paige.
You're in way over your head, kid.
Not everyone gets a happy ending, Paige.
The legend was way more impressive than the reality.
Time thief? Please, you're just a petty crook.
Paradox won't be bothering us for a while.
Crawl back to whatever hole you were hiding in, Paradox.
Takes more than that to stop me, Paradox!
You have a trust fund, why are you wasting your time here?
That bag of tricks was never gonna get the job done.
You're never completing the ritual, Pocket.
I see the trust fund baby!
We don't have those back in Macomb.
Wish I could give that thing a hug.
It was always gonna end this way, Seven.
I knew I couldn't trust you.
I came here to kill the Troubadour, but I'll settle for you.
Shiv, Shiv, Shiv, when are you gonna wise up?
You're not above the law, Shiv. You're just a shitty biker.
You lost, Shiv. Deal with it.
By the way: Your hair is ridiculous.
You're not the law, Silver, I am!
Another life, we'd probably be friends.
Wish we met on a different day, Silver.
I'm tired of your bunny rabbit bullshit!
Why don't you go play with scarves or something?
I've seen some crazy preachers before, but that's a new one.
I'm going to hell, aren't I?
Probably shouldn't tell the folks back home about this.
Get out of my way, Father!
I'm not getting stopped by a dead man!
It's not homicide when they're already dead.
New York brings out all the crazies...
Victor, just get outta my way and file a missing person's report on your arm or something!
Put on some shoes, for god's sake!
What is wrong with this city?
A lot more snipers here than back in Macomb.
You thought you were safe up there?!
I'm not gettin' bossed around by a pile of goo.
I don't know what that thing was, but I think it's still on me.
Hey Gooey! Slink off into a lake or something.
You're really bad at being a criminal, Vyper.
Thought you were supposed to be tough, Vyper.
You picked the wrong day to mess with me, Warden.
Only one of us gets to take the law into their own hands.
Was only a matter of time before I had to put you down, Warden.
I'm lucky Wraith didn't get the drop on me.
I'm not on your payroll, Wraith.
God, that lady creeps me out...
One less crime lord to deal with.
Hey Yamato! Next time you try to lead by example, be competent.
That sword was never gonna get it done.
Holliday brought them right to us!
I'm using this, but I'm not happy about it.
I pay your salary, Holliday, I can use this!
Wasn't very sporting, but who cares?
Keep your wits about you, sheriff.
Be back when I can, Holliday.
Holliday did her part. Now we need to do ours.
You need to help the sheriff!
I'll follow in the sheriff's footsteps.
I knew I could count on you, Holliday.
You make that hat work, Sheriff!

彼女は雇う価値がありそうだ。
役に立ちそうな女だな。
ホリデーもなかなかやるな。
Picked a bad time to visit New York.
If I wanna solve my case, I gotta end yours.
She didn't live up to family name.

She'll come back eventually... and then I'll finish what I started.
You were never gonna beat me, Holliday!
I did what I had to do.
She never should have challenged me!
One less pig to deal with.
Cops are always tryin' to pick on the little guy.
You're not a servant of the law, you're a maniac, cop!
I want your badge number, Holliday!
I'm gonna get outta here, and I'm gonna kick your ass!

You should've stayed in whatever backwater town you came from.
Hollidayǃ Your grandfather would be rolling in his grave.
You weren't ready for this fight, Holliday.
A small-town sheriff couldn't accomplish what Scotland Yard has been trying to do for years. Surprise, surpise.
You ain't the law here, Holliday!
There's things in this world that you don't understand, Holliday.
The sheriff will be back, I know it.
New York does not suit you, Holliday.
Go back to the cornfields where you were safe.
No wonder the Troubadour toyed with her, she's no threat!
And so, once again, the sheriff runs from her responsibilities!
I can only imagine the horrors you witnessed in Macomb. Rest, Holliday, and put aside your trauma for tomorrow.
You failed to stop the Troubadour in Macomb, and you’ll fail again in New York.
Don't worry about the Troubadour, sheriff, worry about me.
I should have given the Troubadour some professional courtesy!
Came a long way just to die here, sheriff.
You know, I like this so much, I might pay Macomb a visit later.
Come on, sheriff! You didn't come all the way to New York just to hide from monsters.
My friends don't appreciate being dragged around by you.
Oh God, the law's after me, that's great...
Shouldn't you be tracking down a serial killer or something, not worrying about a high school kid?
That should buy me a little time.
You'd think the sheriff would have better things to do than hassle me.
I won't let the law stand in my way!
